newsitem.title: CHINA: ATHLETICS-CHINA'S MA COACHES AT ALTITUDE FOR GAMES.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-CHINA'S MA COACHES AT ALTITUDE FOR GAMES.

text.p: Top Chinese athletics coach Ma Junren has begun training runners on the high altitude plateau of western Qinghai province in preparation for October's national games, an official said on Tuesday.

A group of 45 athletes, coaches and doctors, including world 1,500-metre record holder Qu Yunxia, were training at the Duoba plateau sports centre, some 2,300-metres (7,545 ft) above sea level, the official of the State Physical Culture and Sports Commission said.
Ma used the high altitude centre when training his once-formidable "Ma Family Army" team of women distance runners, the official said.
China's Eighth National Games are scheduled from October 12 to 14 in Shanghai.
The former "Ma Family Team", which shattered three world records in 1993, broke up a year later when several members, led by world champion Wang Junxia, mutinied over Ma's draconian coaching methods.
Wang Junxia went on to win the 5,000-metre gold medal at last year's Atlanta Olympics.
